recipes.name: One-Bowl Double Chocolate Banana Muffins
instructions: Add the ground flaxseeds and water to a large bowl. Mix, and set aside for 5 minutes to gel.
Lightly grease or line a muffin pan and preheat oven to 375°F (190°C)*.
Add the bananas to the flaxseed mixture and mash well.
Whisk in the sugar, applesauce, coconut oil, and vanilla.
Add the cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder, and salt, and mix again.
Then add the flour, mixing until partly combined. Then gently fold in the chocolate. Be careful not to over-mix

Evenly divide the batter into the prepared muffin tin. Top each muffin with extra chocolate chunks, if desired, and bake on the middle rack of the oven for about 15 to 20 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the centre comes out clean.
Allow the muffins to cool in the tin for a few minutes before transferring them to a cooling rack to cool completely. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Refined coconut oil is coconut oil that doesn't smell or taste like coconuts. If you prefer a distinct coconut taste, use unrefined coconut oil instead. † We use 50 - 60% cocoa chocolate for a balanced sweetness. Darker varieties (70%+) can make the result too bitter. * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection).
Storage Store in an airtight container on the counter for up to 2 days. Store in the freezer for up to 3 weeks.
